description: This file contains a PHP class named Basic which is a controller for managing the 'Basic' theme extension in the admin area of OpenCart. It includes methods for displaying the theme configuration page and saving settings.

classes.name: Basic
classes.description: A controller class for the OpenCart admin theme extension 'Basic' that provides functionality to display and save theme settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the theme configuration page, including breadcrumbs, header, footer, and current settings.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of theme settings via an AJAX request, with permission checks and JSON response.
